scope: General information about title consequences following transfer and succession of registered land; not a property-specific title determination.

sources: Registration of Deeds and Title Act 2006
current Land Registry registration procedures and official property-record services

verified_boundaries: A person may have a right to be registered without yet appearing as the registered proprietor.
Death, succession entitlement, assent or transfer, and registration are separate stages that may need separate evidence.
The ownership form must be established before deciding whether survivorship or succession applies.
Registered charges and burdens remain separate title layers and require separate verification.
A current folio is not necessarily sufficient to reconstruct a historical title state.
property_specific_gate: Current registered ownership, historical title, charge status, co-ownership and other property-specific conclusions require authoritative records matched to the property and relevant date.
